question: Does separately supervising goal relevance and present information need reduce unnecessary delivery while preserving needed evidence, under partial observations and same-history role contrasts?
data_scope: Reviewed literal fragments of existing Mem2Act source passages. Derived field-recovery requests and controlled current observations, not newly collected independent experiences or live tool completion.
partition: Keep original source_scale train/dev group assignment; no original test or BEAM confirmation examples enter this study. All variants of a source remain together. Dev sources are previously observed development sources, not fresh confirmation.
labels: goal_link = supplies a requested attribute regardless of current observations; needed_now = supplies a requested attribute not already confirmed. Explicit coverage and source spans are audited separately. Actual worker effects never replace these labels.

training.final_checkpoint: last epoch; no best-dev checkpoint selection
training.loss: State-balanced cross entropy on need. Dual adds goal-link CE. Dual_replay additionally uses prior train need labels. Same new examples, updates, initialization and replay forward passes for all arms; unused loss terms have zero weight.

replay: 80 old train states, one per source group when available, excluding source groups of the new study. Deterministic mode-balanced selection. Partial old labels remain masked. Record every actual exposure.
selection: Fixed need probability >=0.5, sorted by probability, shared 512-token cap. Dev threshold/ROC curves may be diagnostic only, never a new confirmed policy.
evaluation: Report source-grouped need discrimination, goal-link discrimination, full missing-field coverage, unnecessary delivery, paired-state correctness and rendering consistency. Re-evaluate old source_scale dev and context_value dev as previously observed retention diagnostics.

worker.task: Recover requested fields as a JSON object; never execute an external tool.

worker_policy: Evaluate all predeclared policies on every dev state in the direct rendering. Reuse only byte-identical messages and worker settings; do not select rows by observed gain. Match canonical strings or explicitly reviewed aliases, separate unsupported correct guesses and partial-field correctness.
resource_rule: One local GPU process at a time, require native BF16 and >=10GiB free before loading; never interrupt another user's process. Exit after bounded work and preserve incomplete status on failure.
reporting: Source-grounded controlled augmentation and a bounded training comparison. Do not claim new natural trajectories, independent confirmation, causal superiority of data size, or live task success. Report simple baselines even when they match or beat learning. Keep original frozen data and checkpoints unchanged.

predecessor.reason: Source qa_351 says between USD and EUR, without establishing base/quote direction. Replace unsupported directional fields with the literal currency-pair phrase. Same dev, model, losses, seeds, epochs and evaluation policy. Earlier scores remain exploratory and are not pooled.
